videos.title: 민법 기초개념 강의 제34강 소멸시효 중단 II
videos.subtitle_summary:
The user wants a summary of a YouTube video transcript about civil law, specifically about "extinction of prescription (소멸시효) interruption II".
Key points from the transcript:
1. This is a continuation of the previous lecture about prescription interruption
2. Focuses on "bankruptcy procedure participation (파산 절차 참가)" as a way to interrupt prescription under Civil Law Article 171
3. Explanation of bankruptcy: when debts exceed assets, the debtor applies to court, and the court initiates bankruptcy proceedings
4. Once bankruptcy is applied, creditors cannot file individual lawsuits or enforcement actions against the debtor (prohibition order)
5. Therefore, participating in bankruptcy proceedings has the same effect as filing a lawsuit for prescription interruption purposes
6. The interruption effect remains unless the creditor cancels participation or the request is dismissed
